newsitem.title: USA: Bone Care expenses rise on drug trial spending.
newsitem.headline: Bone Care expenses rise on drug trial spending.

text.p: Bone Care International Inc said Monday expanded clinical trial spending was a factor in a widening of losses in the second quarter ended December 31.

"We expanded our clinical studies in the quarter," said Bone Care spokesman Dale Gutman. "We're spending more on processing patients, which we need to do to get before the (Food and Drug Administration) and get these products to market."
The company reported a net loss of $776,000 in the latest period, compared to a net loss of $326,000 one year ago. Revenues were $35,000 versus $6,514 last year, Bone Care said.
Bone Care is a pharmaceutical company that is developing improved Vitamin D therapies for hyperparathyroidism, osteoporosis, prostate cancer, breast cancer and psoriasis.
Its shares were trading up 1/2 Monday at 7-3/4.
